title: ISW-Agent: Integrating LLM-Driven Dialogue with n8n Workflow for Internal Solitary Wave Remote Sensing Image Processing
abstract: arXiv:2610.21502v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Internal solitary wave (ISW) remote sensing requires task parameters and spatial information to be transferred across image acquisition, detection, stripe extraction, and propagation prediction. Here, we present ISW-Agent, which integrates large language model (LLM) interpretation with n8n workflows and independent scientific models through structured task constraints, geospatial transformations, and stage-specific output validation. In tests of 120 Chinese instructions per backend, GPT-5.6 Sol and DeepSeek both achieved a strict task-match rate of 94.2%, with all intents and execution decisions matching the reference. Sentinel-1 cases demonstrated continuous processing from dialogue requests to wavefront prediction for the specified scene. Of 50 timed scenes, 39 completed detection, extraction, and prediction with a median turnaround time of 48.04 s; 11 stopped after empty extraction. translated_title: ISW-Agent：将大语言模型驱动的对话与n8n工作流集成用于内孤立波遥感图像处理
translated_abstract: 内孤立波（ISW）遥感需要在图像获取、检测、条纹提取和传播预测等多个环节之间传递任务参数和空间信息。本文提出了ISW-Agent，它通过结构化任务约束、地理空间变换和分阶段输出验证，将大语言模型（LLM）解释与n8n工作流及独立科学模型集成在一起。在针对每个后端各120条中文指令的测试中，GPT-5.6 Sol和DeepSeek均达到了94.2%的严格任务匹配率，所有意图和执行决策均与参考结果一致。Sentinel-1案例展示了从对话请求到指定场景波前预测的连续处理流程。在50个计时场景中，39个完成了检测、提取和预测，中位周转时间为48.04秒；11个在条纹提取为空后停止。在3,408次受控故障注入运行中……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了ISW-Agent系统，通过将大语言模型对话解释与n8n工作流和独立科学模型相集成，实现了从中文对话指令到内孤立波遥感图像检测、条纹提取和传播预测的端到端自动化处理，任务匹配率达94.2%，中位处理周转时间仅48.04秒。
en_tdlr: ISW-Agent integrates LLM-driven dialogue with n8n workflows and independent scientific models to enable end-to-end automated processing of internal solitary wave remote sensing imagery, achieving a 94.2% strict task-match rate and a median turnaround time of 48.04 seconds from conversational requests to wavefront prediction.
